data.command: Tell me about your network configuration

data.text:
My network configuration.  Well, I've got a pretty standard setup here. I'm running Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS on a machine with kernel 5.15.0-91. We're connected to the network via a single Ethernet interface, enp0s3 (which is also known as eth0 in some older systems), with an IP address of 192.168.1.100 and a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0. Our default gateway is at 192.168.1.1.

As for DNS, we're using the Google Public DNS servers at 8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4. I've also added a local hosts file entry to resolve 'example.com' to our internal server at 192.168.1.200.

Here's what my /etc/network/interfaces file looks like:
```
# /etc/network/interfaces -- configuration file for ifup(8) and ifdown(8)
source /etc/network/interfaces.d/*

# The loopback network interface
auto lo
iface lo inet loopback

# The primary network interface
auto enp0s3
iface enp0s3 inet static
  address 192.
